tool_schemas.name: think
tool_schemas.description: Appends the provided `thought` text as a new, append-only thought-log entry for the authenticated API key within its current workspace/tenant, and returns the created log record (including its ID, timestamp, actor, and workspace) as acknowledgement. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the key is not permitted to write to the target workspace, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when write-rate or quota limits for the key/workspace are exceeded. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `thought` is missing, not a string, or violates size/content constraints enforced by the service.

tool_schemas.name: workspaces_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces visible to the authenticated API key (typically its own workspace), with optional filtering by status. Returns a paginated result set. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or belongs to a non-active workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: workspaces_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single workspace by ID. Returns the workspace record if accessible to the authenticated API key. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: workspaces_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable workspace fields and/or performs a workspace lifecycle transition via `status`. Returns the updated workspace. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted, and CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed (active↔suspended, active/suspended→deleted; deleted is terminal).

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain thought logs before expiration.

daily_thought_limit.description: Maximum number of think calls allowed per day for the workspace.

daily_char_limit.description: Maximum total thought characters allowed per day for the workspace.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists API keys for the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered by status. Returns a paginated result set (key material is never returned; only metadata such as id, name, status, key_prefix, and last_used_at). Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or its workspace is not active.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to list keys for. If omitted, defaults to the caller's workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: thought_logs_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists thought log entries for a workspace with filtering and pagination. Returns append-only audit history; thought text may be a redaction placeholder for redacted entries. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the requested workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not visible.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID. If omitted, defaults to the caller's workspace.

api_key_id.description: Filter to entries created by a specific API key id.

created_at_gte.description: Only return entries created at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_at_lte.description: Only return entries created at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

client_request_id.description: Filter by client_request_id (useful for idempotency/audit lookup).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

metadata.name: Think Tool Server
